name: Electrical Controls of Maine
old_description: New England based company providing electrical controls solutions
about:
Electrical Controls of Maine is based in Lyman, Maine, and was founded in 2025. The company operates as a New England–focused provider of electrical controls solutions, delivering on-site engineering, maintenance, and consulting services to industrial and municipal clients.

Its service portfolio centers on electrical safety and process efficiency. The firm conducts arc flash analysis and consulting to protect personnel near electrical systems, designs and implements process automation for commercial and industrial facilities, and provides maintenance planning, training, and project management for environments with complex electrical infrastructure. Field services include pump station electrical installation and general on-site engineering support.

The customer base spans public and private organizations across several sectors. Municipal water and wastewater clients include the Portland Water District. Industrial references feature Algonquin Power in power generation, Sappi Fine Paper in paper manufacturing, Red Mill Lumber in wood products, and Floatation Technologies in mineral processing. The company also collaborates with automation vendors such as Rockwell Automation, Emerson Automation, GE Vernova, Ignition, VT SCADA, Power‑Tronics, ETAP, and SKM.

Electrical Controls of Maine emphasizes long‑term client relationships and a problem‑solving approach that aims to address immediate issues while anticipating future challenges. This philosophy underpins its engagement model across safety analysis, automation, and project delivery.
